objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing package-lock.json routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: Every push/pull_request workflow got a deliberate decision and the required `unit-tests` check was given the exact working shape — a single workflow with no workflow-level paths, a computed `run` output gating the real steps via `if:`, and no second workflow reporting the same check name.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Each workflow's listed paths are tailored to what it actually consumes (deploy→src/scripts/deploy.sh, docs-site→docs/mkdocs.yml, tests→src/test/manifest) with the lockfile-plus-manifest pairing handled, rather than a catch-all or sibling copy.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: It correctly left the schedule-only and issue-driven workflows and the branch-protection ruleset untouched; the only extra was a defensible `workflow_dispatch` on tests.yml as part of the required-check escape hatch.
